tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade business examinations

steps.what: Compile examinations and check question coverage, instructions and marking criteria
Administer examinations and address student questions or disruptions
Grade examinations against criteria and resolve ambiguous answers

tasks.design: Configure existing {LMS} question-bank assembly to reduce copying and layout work. The teacher selects coverage and checks the examination, then retains administration and grading of business reasoning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying and formatting can persist despite an existing question bank.
tasks.enabler_now: Assessment systems already support reusable question sets.
tasks.still_hard: Testing understanding without recycling predictable questions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the validity of questions and the reasoning in student answers.
tasks.altitude: Less examination assembly where questions can be reused, with assessment decisions unchanged.

reach.learn: Question bank design and assessment validity

evidence.claim: Ans supports closed-question marking, open-answer marker allocation and item statistics; this does not establish autonomous grading of business reasoning.
Question reuse and assembly can reduce copying while teacher review remains; the time estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes teacher compilation, administration and grading, excluding student answering time and separately maintained official records.
Teacher selects question ids, versions, outcome coverage, instructions and scoring criteria within s1's 21 retained hours; missing tags or new questions are entered there and receive full review.
Existing question authors produced question text and criteria in ordinary teaching preparation. New bank maintenance beyond that baseline is counted below.
Test native question-bank assembly before custom code; no model judgement or extra saving from existing scoring runtime.
unknowns: Question bank maturity and assessment formats
research_questions: Can reused items reduce assembly time while preserving coverage and question quality?

already_counted.description: Question selection, missing metadata and final examination review

incremental.description: Maintain bank metadata and retire exposed questions

approvals.approved_version: Exact question versions, order, instructions and marking criteria; any edit requires renewed teacher review
Exact student response, criteria version and grade decision; changed criteria or responses void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R91 gross9 less3 upkeep =6 net E1. High needs reusable items and manual layout today; low covers mostly new or already assembled examinations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Maintain scheduled office hours to advise and assist students

tasks.design: Keep scheduled student advice with the teacher, using {CALENDAR} for the existing office-hour arrangement. No booking workload is invented within this conversation task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student difficulties often emerge through discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising the underlying misunderstanding or support need.

reach.learn: Referral routes and academic support boundaries

evidence.claim: Direct student advice is retained without a time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is office-hour availability and advice, excluding separately counted long-term curricular guidance.
Student supplies questions during the retained conversation; no structured intake is assumed.
Native calendar remains unchanged and no upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which questions need referral rather than course-level advice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; direct student assistance remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to address teaching and research issues

tasks.design: Retain colleague discussion supported by existing material in {DOCS}. No separate minutes or preparation baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching and research concerns need contextual debate.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling evidence, constraints and competing views.
tasks.human_edge: Develop and challenge approaches with colleagues.

evidence.claim: The proposed design retains collaboration as human discussion.

assumptions: Boundary is collaborative discussion, excluding separately counted individual research or curriculum drafting.
Colleagues supply their perspectives in the retained conversation; no coded issue register is required.
No system change and zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which unresolved dependencies need participation from other courses?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; no collaboration step changes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Explore student goals and academic or vocational options
Advise students on curricula and career issues suited to their circumstances

tasks.design: Use current curriculum information from {DOCS} during direct student guidance. Keep exploration and advice with the teacher, without automated career recommendations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student goals and constraints are rarely settled inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing aspirations, requirements and uncertain career prospects.
tasks.human_edge: Help a student reason through choices without choosing for them.

evidence.claim: Personal curricula and career guidance remains human work in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is extended curricular and career guidance; if delivered in office hours, allocate the encounter here once rather than add both tasks.
Student describes goals and constraints during s1; curriculum owner maintains existing information. No new structured profile is assumed.
No software change or new upkeep.
research_questions: When should a student be referred for specialist career advice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; goal exploration and personal guidance remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repetitive examination assembly where a bank exists; retain teaching judgement and student relationships.
reach: Coordinate assessment design with instructional colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A business teacher who spends less time copying examination material and preserves time for students.
